title_en: No Waiter Comes Unless You Do This 🔔 #shorts
description_en: Korean restaurants don't come to you — you call, or you press the bell on the table. Learn 저기요 (excuse me), 띵동 (ding dong) and 이모 (auntie). Stock footage: Pexels (free license)
